# Packet — king-list-uruk-ii-to-kish-iii: Uruk, Ur, Adab, Mari, and the tavern-keeper queen (IV 45 – V 43)

Langdon 1923, his transliteration as printed (accents kept; convert to modern subscript indices by SIGN, not by arithmetic — e.g. his dé is the NE sign, de₃). Langdon's [ ] = restored; marks/notes from the transcription are given per line. Read every sign on the plate.

## Images (source/pages/)

- transliteration pages: langdon1923_0019.jpg, langdon1923_0020.jpg
- plates: langdon1923_0043.jpg, langdon1923_0044.jpg (Pl. II, Pl. III)
- the published part king-list-antediluvian.json is the model of shape, notation and register
